headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Kaleykino Oil Pumping Station in Russia's Tatarstan
summary: Ukrainian drones struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station in Tatarstan, a vital hub in Russia's pipeline network, damaging oil storage tanks.
why: Disruptions to key Russian pipeline infrastructure impact regional petroleum distribution and global crude supply availability.

impacts.name: Urals Crude
impacts.why: Drone strikes on a major Russian pipeline pumping hub threaten regional oil export flows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Direct drone attacks on critical oil pipeline infrastructure in Tatarstan raised concerns over potential physical supply constraints from Russia.
